content.summary: Governing condition establishing the scope under which specific eyeglass requirements and permissions apply when eyeglasses are accepted for medical reasons.
content.logic_text: If the eyeglasses are accepted for medical reasons
content.quote: If the eyeglasses are accepted for medical reasons:
applies_to: The frames of the eyeglasses must not cover the eye(s);
There must not be glare on eyeglasses that obscures the eye(s);
There must not be shadows or refraction from the eyeglasses that obscure the eye(s); and
Dark or tinted lenses are permitted if the medical statement also indicates that they are required.

content.summary: Even if a submitted U.S. Certificate of Citizenship or Certificate of Naturalization was recently issued, the photograph depicted on it may not have been taken within six months of submitting the application due to USCIS processing times.
content.action: taken within six months of submitting the application
content.logic_text: even if the certificate itself was recently issued, because of U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services processing times, the photograph may not have been taken within six months of submitting the application
content.quote: Be aware that even if the certificate itself was recently issued, because of U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services processing times, the photograph may not have been taken within six months of submitting the application.
content.scope_text: When applicants wish to re-use a passport photograph depicted on their submitted U.S. Certificate of Citizenship or Certificate of Naturalization.
content.choice_text: U.S Certificate of Citizenship OR Certificate of Naturalization
content.choice_quote: U.S Certificate of Citizenship or Certificate of Naturalization
scope_quotes: Applicants may wish to re-use a passport photograph that is depicted on their submitted U.S Certificate of Citizenship or Certificate of Naturalization.

content.summary: Governing condition establishing the scope of procedures applicable when passport applications are received without photographs.
applies_to: Processing and communications/customer service personnel at passport agencies/centers or consular section personnel should refer applications without photographs to their supervisor for guidance on processing passport applications received without photographs;
You must not accept a form DS-11 or form DS-82 received without a photograph at the public counter.
Passport specialists must suspend a form DS-11 received without a photograph from an acceptance facility.
The applicant must re-execute the form DS-11 (see IRL 975-04);
Passport specialists must suspend a form DS-82 or form DS-5504 received without a photograph (see IRL 1000-05 and IRL 1018-14).
